items.text: `src/infrastructure/comp/manuscript/manuscript-content-stub.adapter.ts` — implements `ManuscriptContentPort`; `getContentTree(projetoId)` returns a fixture tree (`{ manuscritoId: 'fixture-id', estrutura: [{ id: 'img-1', tipo: 'imagem' }, { id: 'p-1', tipo: 'paragrafo' }] }`) or `null` for a known "no-manuscript" project id (configurable via env `COMP_STUB_NO_MANUSCRIPT_IDS`); `nodeExists` returns `true` for any `referenciaNo` not in a configured denial list
`src/modules/comp/comp.module.ts` (amend) — register stub under `MANUSCRIPT_CONTENT_PORT` token when `NODE_ENV !== 'production'` OR when `COMP_USE_STUB_MANUSCRIPT=true`

`src/infrastructure/comp/manuscript/manuscript-content-stub.adapter.spec.ts` — configured no-manuscript id → `getContentTree` returns null; any other → returns fixture tree; `nodeExists` returns true by default
Project id in denial list → `getContentTree` returns null → 409 `manuscript-missing`
`nodeExists` returns true for any `referenciaNo` not in denial list
